title: Gul Dolen Meets Alex Shulgin
description: A Cool Molecules Media microdose from the archive. See [Test Link](https://www.example.com)

transcript.text: I was at MIT as a graduate student at the time and we had just moved into a new building and
as part of the opening ceremony for the new building the university asked all of the faculty
members in the Department of Neuroscience to invite you know famous people that they would want to
kind of speak and be part of the opening ceremony and so almost every other faculty member in the
department invited a Nobel laureate but my faculty advisor Mark Baer invited Alexander
Shoden and the beauty of this was that you know not to disparage any Nobel laureates but you know
they got up there and they were like talking about whatever they had discovered and trying to extrapolate
it to neuroscience and you know mostly it was kind of like you're not a neuroscientist stick
to what you know right and then Shoden got up on stage and he was just so lucid and you know well
versed and just got up there and was like oh and then we added the methyl group over here and
it changed this property and then it made it this and we added it here and he was just like
the most clear unaddled you know most neuroscience friendly speaker of the whole group and
you know if it left you with any doubts that doing a bunch of psychedelics was going to
impair your ability to speak knowledgeably about neuroscience there were no doubts left I mean he
